policy.purpose: Semantic correctness oracle. PASS means the runtime interpretation, canonical integration, query result and explicit role coverage match the curated expectation; no-exception alone is never PASS.
policy.template_rule: A canonical T must cover every role explicitly observed or requested so far. The oracle does not require speculative hidden roles.
policy.gap_rule: ARCHITECTURE_GAP is not a pass. It marks an input whose required canonical semantics/clarification mechanism is not defined by Architecture_v3 yet.

coverage.design: Scenario-isolated black-box suite. The first 40 cases remain one frozen sequential regression scenario; independent stress cases reset to the run baseline; only explicit memory-learning/query chains share a scenario.
coverage.oracle_rule: Every case is EXACT. Failures are evidence to diagnose; the corpus is not pre-shaped to current parser behavior.
coverage.isolation_rule: Canonical AH, InteractionContext, and Ignition state reset to the acceptance baseline whenever scenario changes. Template/query accumulation is tested only inside intentionally shared scenarios.
